question: In October 2019, who became the youngest cricketer in the world to score a double century in List A cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yashasvi Jaiswal**__.

__
 
• In October 2019, **Yashasvi Jaiswal** became the **youngest cricketer in the world to score a double century in List A cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yashasvi Bhupendra Kumar Jaiswal** is an Indian cricketer who plays for **Mumbai in domestic cricket** and **Rajasthan Royals** in the Indian Premier League.
 
• He was the leading **run-scorer of the India U-19 team** and **player of the tournament at the 2020** Under-19 World Cup in South Africa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****__Atharva Ankolekar__**

__
 
• Atharva Ankolekar is an Indian cricketer who plays for India Under-19s.
 
• He was the** highest wicket-taker** at the 2019 ACC Under-19 Asia Cup and player of the match in the final.

**Ravi Bishnoi**__

__
 
• Ravi Bishnoi is an Indian cricketer who plays for **Rajasthan in domestic cricket** and **Lucknow Super Giants in the Indian Premier League**.
 
• He played for India in the 2020 Under-19 Cricket World Cup, finishing as the tournament's **highest wicket-taker with 17 dismissals**.
 
• He made his international debut for the India cricket team in **February 2022**.

**Dhruv Jurel**__

 
• Dhruv Jurel is an Indian cricketer who plays for Rajasthan Royals in the Indian Premier League.
 
• He made his **Twenty20 debut** on **10 January 2021**, for Uttar Pradesh in the 2020–21 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy.
 
• He was named as the **Vice-Captain** of India's squad for the **2020 Under-19 Cricket World Cup**.
